meta_description: Agents made generating code cheap. The real bottleneck is now verification: checking that a change is correct, follows repo conventions, and is something your team can trust, review, and merge. This post introduces the full verification stack — a layered set of automated verifiers that catch different mistakes at different stages, so coding agents fail fast and humans only spend time on changes worth merging.
